name: House Tour with Zyzy!
source:
An educational visual novel designed for children to explore the meaning of home and learn important lessons about house safety. Through interactive storytelling and engaging visuals, kids will discover what makes a home safe and welcoming, one room at a time!

From the bubbly bathroom where slips and trips can happen, to the fun-filled living room where hidden dangers hide in plain sight, all the way to the busy kitchen filled with sharp tools and hot surfaces, and lastly, the cozy bedroom where loose cords and toys on the floor can lead to unexpected accidents... 

And remember kids!

A home is where you are safe!

A home is where you are loved!

A home is where you are cherished.  Just for being alive. 

[Edited from [url=https://hundredsidedsky.itch.io/house-tour-with-zyzy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部教育视觉小说，专为儿童探索家庭的意义并学习有关家庭安全的重要课程而设计。通过互动故事讲述和引人入胜的视觉效果，孩子们将发现如何让一个家变得安全和温馨，一次一个房间！

从可能发生滑倒和绊倒的充满活力的浴室，到隐藏着危险的充满乐趣的客厅，一直到充满锋利工具和灼热表面的繁忙厨房，最后，地板上松散的绳索和玩具可能导致意外事故的舒适卧室…… 

并记住孩子们！

家就是你安全的地方！

家就是被爱的地方！

家是你被珍惜的地方。只为活着。

[编辑自[url=https://hundredsidedsky.itch.io/house-tour-with-zyzy]itch.io[/url]]
